meta.title: Improve CompactMap array operations with binary search
meta.body_summary: Add binary search to CompactMap's internal compact array operations (put, get, containsKey, remove) and include tests for sorted ordering.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added binary search to CompactMap internal operations; no review, self-merged within seconds.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 188 changed lines across 2 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor by absolute volume. It fits a targeted algorithmic optimization (binary search) and was merged almost instantly without review, consistent with a low-risk self-merged change.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal reviews or comments exist in the dataset; the PR was merged by the author 22 seconds after creation.
review_details.performance_claim: Binary search improves lookup/insert/removal performance in CompactMap by replacing linear scans.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Implementing binary search on a sorted compact array is a standard algorithmic optimization; the agent successfully delivered the feature with tests, and the maintainer self-merged without external review.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler output; only narrative claim of performance improvement without before/after numbers.

core_change_summary.description: In CompactMap.java, introduced pairBinarySearch for even-indexed key lookups and integrated it into putInCompactArray, get, containsKey, and removeFromCompactArray to replace linear scans; added tests in CompactOrderingTest.java for sorted ordering.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Only two files changed: core logic and tests.
